Source Monster

Monster: Rey Dau | CR: 14 | Tier: 3

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Hunting Horn Only) Lord's Favor. When you complete a melody, your hunting horn deals an extra 1d12 bludgeoning damage until the end of your next turn.

Armor Effect

You have advantage on saving throws against being stunned while you wear this armor.
